label: Actual process and organizational structure
scope: Actual occurrence, common constitutive signature; finite K is a model, not proof of completeness.
status: Definition/source consolidation, not a discovered universal boundary algorithm.

label: Structural-experiential identity
scope: Same actual token; complete common sorts/relations; experiential interpretation explicitly assumed.
status: Current axiom, not independently established by constructing an isomorphic object.

label: Basal phenomenal consciousness
scope: Nonempty distinguished support; conceptual-self nonnecessity needs an actual non-self witness.
status: Definition and inherited conditional consequences; not clinical consciousness or all minimal-self claims.

label: Fixed-contract capability
scope: Tasks, environments, timing, resources, adaptation, evaluated process and scoring fixed; type-invariant well-defined expectation.
status: Definition; not unique universal intelligence or a richness scale.

label: Functional self-model
scope: Grounded actual target and attachments, common legal plans, installed m/d; accuracy, use and internal attribution separate.
status: Restricted functional definition, not definition of every felt self.

label: Selected self-experiential question
scope: A selected experiential query q must first be specified; q(e) is only a target-typing convention.
status: No new phenomenal bridge or measured mineness is supplied.

label: Complete type and fixed capability
scope: Exact underlying profiles on realized complete-type image.
status: Inherited result; proof included. Noninjectivity is required for a full-identification failure witness.

label: Complete-target compatibility
scope: Same actual comparison processes, intervals and complete signature; functions defined on realized images; injectivity form separately assumes r=bk.
status: Classical factorization application; complete proof included; no historical novelty for factorization.

label: Selected targets and error obstruction
scope: Common target law and legal plan; abstract decoder existence separate from installation.
status: Classical factorization and triangle-inequality applications; proofs included.

label: Prediction versus assembly attachment
scope: n>=2, bijections, all commands independently legal, fixed timing/no additional coupling; beta fixed independently.
status: Project counterexample using elementary algebra; no ownership phenomenology inferred.

label: Conditional complete-type interpretation
scope: Actual comparison tokens and genuinely constitutive beta-retaining roles; complete isomorphisms must preserve represented distinction.
status: Additional physical premise explicit; no proof of unique subject or transfer of feeling.

label: All ancestors and intermediate formation
scope: E1 uses U1 and actual comparison family; E3 separately assumes continuous binary predicate.
status: Motivation and existing conditional routes; no physical-graduality-only proof.

label: Inference and purpose audit
scope: Declared relation types, simultaneous premises, source versions and research question.
status: Research method and worked failure analysis, not a new theorem about all possible theories.
